say:1:1610630001:1.text: What happened just now? Why did the alarm go off?
say:1:1610630001:1.source_cn: 刚才发生了什么？怎么会突然响起警报？

say:3:1610630002:1.text: Oh, nothing serious. A cat snuck in from somewhere and triggered the alarm.
say:3:1610630002:1.source_cn: 哈，没什么。有只猫儿不知道从哪里溜了进来，触发了警报。

say:6:1610630005:1.text: Shouldn't we double-check? What if someone actually slipped in and used the cat as a distraction?
say:6:1610630005:1.source_cn: 啊……不需要再检查一下了吗？或许有什么人进来了，那只猫...

say:7:1610630006:1.text: No need to worry, Headmistress Durella. The interrogation chambers here are well protected. Let's continue. The longer we delay, the more anxious Her Majesty will be.
say:7:1610630006:1.source_cn: 杜瑞拉女士，不必担忧，审讯室有严格的安保机制。我们得抓...

say:8:1610630007:1.text: As I said earlier, I need to speak with <style="highlight">Niall</style>.
say:8:1610630007:1.source_cn: 正如我刚才所说，我需要和<style=highligh...

say:9:1610630008:1.text: If you insist that much, I suppose I can't be too concerned for a student's health... Not when Her Majesty herself is waiting for your report.
say:9:1610630008:1.source_cn: ……你如此坚持，看来我也不能太在乎学生的身体健康了，毕...

say:10:1610630009:1.text: That's right, Headmistress Durella. As the Lightbearer Envoy, I must put the Empire's interests first.
say:10:1610630009:1.source_cn: 杜瑞拉女士，你说得没错。身为帝国特使，我必须将帝国的利...

say:11:1610630010:1.text: Then I have no reason to refuse. I will bring Niall in.
say:11:1610630010:1.source_cn: 看来我没有拒绝的理由……好吧，我去把尼尔带来。
